evidence: Single package ('sacremoses') with flat internal structure (no subpackages beyond data/, test/, and top-level modules)
Well-defined modules (tokenize.py, normalize.py, truecase.py, etc.) each encapsulating a single responsibility (tokenization, normalization, truecasing)
Clear dependency direction: core modules (corpus, util) are imported by higher-level modules (tokenize, truecase, etc.), indicating cohesive internal boundaries
Shared data files (nonbreaking_prefixes, perluniprops) co-located with logic in same package, no external service boundaries
CLI and test modules co-located with production code in same repository, typical of a self-contained monolith
No evidence of network boundaries, remote calls, or inter-process communication — only Python imports and local module usage
